turns.say: Abeg, wetin be inflation?
turns.reply: Inflation na the rise wey the general level of prices for goods and services go increase over time. As prices go up, the purchasing power of your naira go fall, meaning say the same amount of money fit buy less things than before. It usually happen when there’s more money in circulation than the amount of goods and services available, or when production costs (like wages, raw materials, transport) go up and sellers pass those costs to buyers. Central banks, like the Central Bank of Nigeria, try to control inflation by adjusting interest rates and using other monetary policies.
